description: This file defines the AWS PrivateNetworksClient class used to interact with AWS Private 5G services within the SDK. It extends the AwsClient base class and declares multiple methods related to network and device management, mostly as placeholders for dynamic method handling. It also contains method annotations for IDE support and documentation.

classes.name: PrivateNetworksClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Private 5G services, inheriting behavior from AwsClient and providing method signatures for network and device management operations.
